batch_policy: existing public APIs; SQLite batch currently loops row transactions, Lance uses batch merge
cache_policy: no OS cache flush; reopen and warm labels refer to this process/fixture only
compilation_policy: compilation excluded from executable timings; record cargo wall separately; both arms share binary/profile
correctness_gate: all expected unique query receipts accounted; no API errors/duplicate IDs/missing rows; recall@10=1.0; all 1000 IDs, bitwise float32 vectors and provider/model/hash/timestamp metadata verified after initial batch and after mixed writes (20 changed metadata rows, 980 unchanged)
cost_policy: provider calls/tokens/charges zero by construction; no infrastructure pricing assumption
oracle: exhaustive float64 cosine; descending score then lexicographic symbol ID
order_limitation: fixed-order single pass; OS cache/order effects are not controlled and no comparative significance is established
performance_gate: none; descriptive small diagnostic, not a backend promotion or production latency claim
process_isolation: one fresh child process and TempDir per backend
query_repetition_policy: 20 distinct queries: one first-after-reopen search plus20warm plus16readers*20mixed searches=341 calls per backend
reader_topology: independent handles in one process; not 16 MCP processes
validation_timing_policy: full-row validation is separately timed after initial batch and after mixed writes; report requested-ID copying, public read API and payload/metadata comparison separately; do not fold validation into upsert/search API latency
vector_kind: synthetic finite normalized float32; no semantic-quality interpretation
writer_mode: same vector payload, changed metadata; bounded concurrent burst, not steady state
